first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports simplification as a durable way to improve early adoption and time-to-value. A small guarded test is preferable to broad discounting because promotional pricing may recover price-sensitive SMB acquisition but could reduce qualified-revenue quality and margin. Verify the onboarding records and the pricing record before committing.

final.rationale: Run a standard A/B test of a shorter onboarding flow, prioritizing SMB and self-serve accounts. This directly addresses the 4% completion decline and 6% activation decline, with confirmed evidence of higher completion, faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention. Signup-field reduction may also help SMB activation but showed a small retention decline, so monitor retention and qualified revenue as guardrails. Do not use promotional pricing: despite strong acquisition and qualified-revenue lift, the 12% retention decline indicates poor sustainable value and first-renewal risk.
